caption: The drawing depicts a single large stoneware jug with a narrow neck, a rounded body, and a handle that extends from the upper shoulder to the neck. The jug is predominantly a light brownish-gray color with a slightly textured surface. A floral or abstract decorative design is painted on the upper part of the jug, near the handle, in varying shades of blue. The jug is placed against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or elements in the composition. There are subtle variations in shading and color on the jug’s surface, indicating its three-dimensional form, and a faint reddish patch is visible near the lower front of the jug.
title: Jug
